recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce R5 Citation/EvidenceReport relatesTo or RelatedArtifact structures in current core source for FHIR-32795. Future changes to current Evidence, EvidenceVariable, ResearchStudy, Composition, or ArtifactAssessment relatesTo.target[x] elements should be handled under the later R6 relationship-design trackers or new work-group decisions, not this R5 Citation/EvidenceReport issue.
issue_request: FHIR-32795 was a Published CDS R5 change request with Persuasive with Modification resolution for Citation and EvidenceReport. The original request asked to replace relatesTo.target[x] with a BackboneElement carrying url, identifier, display, resource, and attachment so a target could be identified by multiple concurrent forms. The final resolution instead said to update the relatesTo element to use the new RelatedArtifact type after FHIR-32973 was applied, and comments clarified that Citation had been handled while EvidenceReport was being deprecated and did not need the change.
initial_application: FHIR-32973 first changed the RelatedArtifact datatype in git commit f2d1f8f99b80 by expanding relationship codes, adding classifier/resourceReference functionality, and removing the standalone url element. FHIR-32795 was then explicitly applied in git commit 3ee1c28e2ffd, which changed Citation.relatesTo, Citation.citedArtifact.relatesTo, and EvidenceReport.relatesTo target[x] from choices into BackboneElement target structures. Shortly afterward, git commit a519c04228cf collapsed the Citation relatesTo structures to RelatedArtifact, and the FHIR-33119 commit fa06f9231615 renamed Citation.relatesTo to Citation.relatedArtifact.
additional_context: MnM minutes on 2021-06-23 record that FHIR-32795 prompted the RelatedArtifact metadatatype discussion that became FHIR-32973, and later CDS agendas identify FHIR-33119 as overlapping with the already approved FHIR-32795 RelatedArtifact vote. Later R6 decisions superseded the R5 shape: FHIR-49758 removed RelatedArtifact from EBM resources and introduced explicit relatesTo BackboneElement structures with target[x] choices, FHIR-53002 changed relatesTo.type to CodeableConcept, and FHIR-50010 simplified the RelatedArtifact datatype itself. Current source scope is different again: EvidenceReport is removed/replaced by an EBM IG Composition profile, and Citation source files have also been removed from the active build.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The FHIR-32795 request was historically applied to the then-current Citation/EvidenceReport sources, then superseded by later final R6 decisions, and the current build has no active Citation or EvidenceReport source location where the R5 tracker could require a correction.
